title: Every leak becomes a test: a field guide to our sanitiser.
description: Real leaks our log sanitiser missed, each paired with the test line that now stops it. A field guide to failing closed, from 14 to 21 November 2026.
lede: Our log sanitiser is never finished. It is a list of everything that got through once. Here are the leaks, and the test line each one left behind.
summary: The sanitiser behind Agent Idea fails closed. This is a tour of the leaks reviews found in it, and the one-line tests that keep each one shut.
